title: "About"
---

I grew up in Dubai in the UAE and left in 2021 for my undergraduate degree.
I went to UBC to study Computer Science with a minor in Lingusitics.
During this time I interned at multiple places mostly in the biological and genomics space.
Most of the work involved data but I wanted to dig deeper.
I also took a couple computational linguistics classes in my undergraduate degree which is where I heard about the MDS-CL.
When I was in my final year, I realized that I really wanted to pursue a career in data.

I love to cook, but I do not do so efficiently. It is more of a meditative exercise for me.
I also play ultimate frisbee and spend a lot of time on Minecraft, mostly modded with tech modpacks so I can automate things in game.
